# Contract Review Skill for Muse

A structured contract review built on the CUAD dataset's 41 risk categories plus LegalBench and ContractEval: it starts with a pre-review completeness check (blank fields, missing exhibits, signature status), frames risks around your position (customer, vendor, buyer, seller), quick-scans red flags — sub-6-month liability caps, uncapped indemnification, unilateral amendment rights, perpetual obligations, offshore jurisdiction — then extracts key terms, proposes concrete redlines with market benchmarks and fallback positions, flags missing provisions (data export rights, SLA credits, price caps), and ranks negotiation priorities. Covering NDAs, SaaS/MSA, payment, M&A, and finder agreements. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: examples and benchmarks lean US (Delaware governing law, M&A escrow norms); the output is informational analysis, not legal advice — have qualified counsel review material terms before signing. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
